verdict: Paid channels are dark; organic presence is fading across all three businesses.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, no paid spend ran on Meta or Google Ads for the full 28-day period, meaning zero paid leads were generated. Google Business Profile was the only active acquisition channel, producing a combined 402 actions (calls, direction requests, and website clicks) across all three locations — but GBP engagement dropped sharply week over week at every entity, with O'Hare down 54%, Forte down 27%, and Advance Grinding down 26%. The CRM pipeline work that underpins outreach and follow-up has open milestones being closed this week, with stub account reconciliation targeted for today and contact lists being pulled now to enable lapsed-customer sequences in September. Organic search visibility is also being addressed: the root cause of the traffic drop has been identified and a fix submitted today, with reindexing expected to show recovery by October.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations this period
paid leads generated this period — all three businesses ran zero paid spend
steepest weekly GBP drop, at O'Hare Precision, in the last 7 days vs. the prior 7

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement is declining at all three locations while paid campaigns remain inactive, leaving no active lead generation channel in place.
watch_item.fix: Paid campaign reactivation is the immediate priority alongside the outreach sequences launching in September; CRM stub reconciliation due today restores the pipeline visibility needed to support both.
